command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; echo '=== shizuku process ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E 'shizuku_server|moe.shizuku.privileged.api' || true; echo '=== app shizuku permission state ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | grep -i -A3 -B3 'moe.shizuku.manager.permission.API_V23' || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm check-permission moe.shizuku.manager.permission.API_V23 pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 2>/dev/null || true
